newsitem.title: USA: PLC Systems hit by 2nd class action suit.
newsitem.headline: PLC Systems hit by 2nd class action suit.

text.p: PLC Systems was hit with a second class action suit following its precipitous stock price drop when an advisory Federal Drug Administration panel rejected the company's heart laser system.

The law firm Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP filed the suit on behalf of shareholders who bought PLC shares between February 13 and July 28 in the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts.

Like the suit filed by Berman, DeValerio & Pease LLP of Boston, the complaint alleges PLC and its executives provided misleading information about the company's medical device and failed to disclose clinical trials were flawed.
A company spokeswoman was not immediately available for comment.
The company's stock dropped to 11-3/8 from 25-5/8 July 29 after the regulatory body rejected its medical device and asked for more clinical data.
PLC said Thursday it would provide regulators with more data in the fall and had stepped up its data collection.
Stock of the developer of medical systems rose 1-1/4 to 13-1/4 Friday.
